trigger: P0579's inverse-derived K0338 endpoint rule improved both SMACS0723 and SPT0615 under a linearized image-plane metric, but narrowly failed its mass-sheet gate. This stage asks whether the fixed geometry survives full nonlinear image-root solving on four independent raw clusters.
question: Does the locked K0338 endpoint geometry improve or stabilize exact held-out image roots when it routes only the scalar parent's excess over baryonic gravity?

locked_geometry.source: P0579 candidate K0338, fixed without reference to these four systems
locked_geometry.concentration: C=R50/R80 from fixed member-light positions and weights about the cluster origin
locked_geometry.return_length: 0.36*R80, constant for all member launch radii
locked_geometry.normalization: (1-s) local member map plus s endpoint map, normalized to unit total weight

field_translation.scalar_parent: P0554 from the frozen arc-invariant Pareto program
field_translation.carrier: P0554 reduced deflection minus baryonic reduced deflection
field_translation.angular_response: multiply the carrier convergence by the normalized endpoint-map contrast, remove its exact annular mean, solve one curl-free potential, and add only the zero-monopole correction to the scalar parent

sensitivity_grid.policy: Fit geometry only for the locked primary. At that fixed fit and its fitted source positions, score exact roots for each one-at-a-time field change; sensitivities cannot replace the primary.

systems.independence: None of these four systems entered the ten-cluster inverse driver that fixed K0338 or the two-cluster P0579 raw replay. They have been used by other formula families in this project.

fit.baseline_policy: Use the already frozen scalar-baseline exact fits from the identical raw-cluster protocol; initialize each new primary fit at that system's scalar geometry.

claim_limits: The four systems are independent of K0338 selection but are not globally fresh to the research project.
Member catalogs omit intracluster gas and diffuse light and were prepared within conventional lens-model workflows.
The scalar P0554 parent is phenomenological; the endpoint correction is not derived from a covariant action.
The correction is explicitly zero-monopole, so this stage tests angular endpoint placement rather than absolute cluster lensing strength.
Only the primary result is predictive; all one-at-a-time sensitivity rankings are descriptive after the exact-root replay.
